extracted.name: Japanese Soufflé Cheesecake
extracted.description: Japanese soufflé cheesecake has lighter in texture and less sweet compared to American style cheesecakes. Watch the video too: https://youtu.be/SCOqMwY_rXw
instruction_lines: Add cream cheese, butter and milk into the pan. Heat the pot over low heat. Watch the video too: https://youtu.be/SCOqMwY_rXw
After everything is evenly mixed, turn off the heat
Add egg yolks and mix well
Use a strainer when adding flour
After all mix together, use strainer to sift the batter so you can get a fine texture after baking. Leave the batter while we are making the meringue
Mix the egg white using mixer machine while gradually add the sugar
Gently mix the batter and the meringue
Transfer into the mold and bake at 160°C for 20 minutes. And then open the oven door for 10 seconds and then bake again at 110°C for another 60 minutes.
Ready to serve:) You also watch the video here: youtu.be/SCOqMwY_rXw
